name: checklist-card
title: Checklist card
description: A titled checklist with a progress count, strike-through on done items and an add row, for launch and packing lists.
docs: items is a list of { id, label, done, note }. onToggle receives the id and the state asked for, onAdd the trimmed text of the add row (Enter adds) and onRemove the id; leave a callback out and its control is not drawn. The count and the bar come from the items, progressLabel changes the words ("{done} of {total} packed"), and when everything is checked the count reads "Everything is checked". hideCompleted folds checked items away behind a button, controlled or with defaultHideCompleted. Each item is a checkbox with its own label in a labelled group; checking, adding and removing are announced, and removing an item, or checking one while the checked items are folded away, moves focus to its neighbour.
